description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeViewModel class used in an Android application. It manages the UI state for multiple category rails on a home screen, handling data loading, error states, and providing interface methods to load and reload categories. It also includes the RailState data class representing the state of each rail.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for a single content rail, including loading indicator, error message, and list of content items.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for loading multiple category rails for the Home screen, managing loading states, errors, and data updates.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Starts loading all category rails in parallel.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Internal function that loads data for a specific category, updating the UI state accordingly.
